fieldNotes.location: Confirmed Anheuser-Busch Cartersville Brewery, 100 Busch Dr NE. Roster coords were ~4.9 km off (geocode movedMeters 4905). Locked center on the main brewery/warehouse mass at 34.25700,-84.78300. Street View at the public-road intersection (34.2538,-84.7863) shows the 'Budweiser' lettering on the brewhouse confirming identity.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Long private access road runs ~700 m NNE from the public road; the entry has a divided entry/exit with chevron-channelized lanes and a small structure in the median where the road splits. Controlled entrance to a fenced industrial campus.
fieldNotes.guardShack: A small median structure at the entry split is consistent with a guard booth; private-road Street View coverage stops at the public road so this is satellite-inferred (medium confidence).
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Entry and exit lanes are divided/channelized with chevron markings at the road split.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Access road is ~700 m long with ample stacking room before reaching the building.
fieldNotes.scale: A scale-house-sized structure sits along the truck route near the trailer-yard side; weigh pad inferred, medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Dock canopies and trailers backed in along the NE warehouse face plus a secondary dock cluster on the SE face; 50+ band, count ~60 estimated from z19-20 imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Extensive multi-row trailer yard NE of the warehouse holding ~180 visible trailers (red Budweiser and white reefer trailers); capacity well above 50.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Distinct dock banks on different building faces (NE warehouse dock vs SE building dock).
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus: main brewhouse/warehouse, packaging hall, ancillary buildings, and a separate small building NE of the trailer yard.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town wooded site off I-75 outside Cartersville, surrounded by farmland and forest - Rural setting.

citations.claim: AB newsroom confirms current operation of the Cartersville GA brewery (since 1993), ~$9.2M equipment upgrade + new training center.

verification.rationale: AB newsroom 2025 expansion press confirms current operation; not among the closures, no negative signal.
